display_name: ATM9 Expert レシピ調査の参照元レジストリ
interpretation: search_order is a discovery order, not a ranking of effective in-game evidence

record_statuses.verified: same modpack release, JEI/EMI or in-game validated
record_statuses.source_parsed: source definition only; runtime validity and pack-version match not confirmed
record_statuses.unknown: cannot claim a recipe is impossible

sources.purpose: validate target version, coverage and pinned upstream source
exact output item ID to recipes file; missing means not indexed, not unobtainable
structured recipe definitions with materials, quantity, source and validation status
sources.rule: read all candidates; output namespace not machine/mod namespace

sources.purpose: check if default or existing recipes are removed or replaced
sources.rule: recipe ID and output item ID differ; removal doesn't imply no alternative

sources.purpose: find customized and dynamic recipes by exact output ID and recipe ID
sources.rule: open actual source; do not execute untrusted JavaScript or infer dynamic expansion

sources.purpose: find file-based crafting and processing recipes; recipe namespace may differ from output namespace
sources.rule: do not infer validity until removals and overrides are examined

sources.purpose: fallback for unchanged vanilla/Mod-provided recipes, using the exact jar versions from the installed pack
sources.rule: requires actual pack files or matching published mod version; unknown otherwise

sources.purpose: progression hints and gates only, not authoritative recipe ingredients
sources.rule: never turn quest task into crafting recipe

sources.purpose: highest-confidence check for effective recipes and machine conditions
sources.rule: mark verified only when the pack release and evidence are recorded
